#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cstring>

const int MOD = 1000000007;

int solve(int n) {
    int size = 2 * n + 1;
    std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<int>>> dp(size, std::vector<std::vector<int>>(size, std::vector<int>(2, 0)));
    dp[0][0][0] = 1;
    for (int depth = 1; depth <= 2 * n; depth++) {
        for (int opened = depth & 1; opened <= depth; opened += 2) {
            int fromPrev0 = 0, fromPrev1 = 0;
            if (opened - 1 >= 0) {
                fromPrev0 += dp[depth - 1][opened - 1][1];
                fromPrev1 += dp[depth - 1][opened - 1][0];
            }
            if (opened + 1 <= n) {
                fromPrev0 += dp[depth - 1][opened + 1][1];
                fromPrev1 += dp[depth - 1][opened + 1][0];
            }
            dp[depth][opened][0] = (fromPrev0 + 1) % MOD;
            dp[depth][opened][1] = fromPrev1 % MOD;
        }
    }
    return dp[2 * n][0][1];
}

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    int ans = solve(n);
    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
